scope.quote: interested in well-defined theoretical results and empirical studies that have potential impact on the construction, analysis, or management of software.

rules.quote: An abstract must clearly state the nature and significance of the paper and is required at the head of the manuscript.
rules.requirement: Include an abstract at the start that states the paper's nature and significance.

rules.quote: Abstracts must not include mathematical expressions or bibliographic references.
rules.requirement: Exclude mathematical expressions and bibliographic references from the abstract.

rules.quote: Coauthor awareness and approval of submission (or any revised version)
rules.requirement: Confirm each coauthor is aware of and approves the submission or revision.

rules.quote: responsible for obtaining copyright releases and corporate and security clearances prior to submitting material
rules.requirement: Obtain required rights and organizational clearances before submission.

rules.quote: We expect the authors to disclose any derivative works and their sources.
rules.requirement: Disclose related derivative works and their sources.

rules.quote: embed the figures and tables where they should appear in the article (as close as possible to the first callout)
rules.requirement: Embed figures and tables close to their first callouts in the journal template.

rules.quote: Citations must include full publication information
rules.requirement: Include complete publication details for cited works.

rules.quote: original source and reference must be provided to the editor at submission and appear in the article itself.
rules.requirement: If review board approval was obtained, provide its source and reference to the editor and in the paper.

rules.quote: must indicate upon article submission whether an approval was obtained from a relevant review board
rules.requirement: For human or animal research, indicate whether relevant review board approval was obtained.

rules.quote: ensure permission to publish images is acquired from all owners and publishers
rules.requirement: Obtain permission to publish any third-party figures or images.

rules.quote: minimum of 300 dpi at the intended display size.
rules.requirement: Provide images and graphs at 300 dpi or higher at display size.

rules.quote: All appendices in journal articles are considered supplemental material.
rules.requirement: Designate each appendix as supplemental material and upload it separately.

rules.quote: Using an article template is required for journal submissions.
rules.requirement: Use the IEEE article template for the TSE submission.

rules.quote: Keywords should be selected from the ACM taxonomy provided in ScholarOne
rules.requirement: Choose specific article keywords from the ACM taxonomy where appropriate.

rules.quote: keep your main manuscript as the first file in the list.
rules.requirement: Place the main manuscript first in the uploaded file list.

rules.quote: We don’t accept articles under review by another publication, including conference proceedings.
rules.requirement: Do not submit work that is under review elsewhere.

rules.quote: We don’t accept papers that have been published elsewhere
rules.requirement: Do not submit work already published elsewhere unless an applicable preliminary-version policy is satisfied and disclosed.

rules.quote: all articles should have numbered references that are listed in the order in which they appear in the body of the paper.
rules.requirement: Number references in order of first appearance.

rules.quote: ORCID), which is required by all IEEE publications.
rules.requirement: Provide an ORCID for the submitting author in the publication's submission system.

rules.quote: you must state your intention to submit in your cover letter
rules.requirement: Disclose in the cover letter any planned conference version of the paper.

rules.quote: provide a brief description of the differences between the submitted manuscript and the preliminary version(s)
rules.requirement: Describe differences from preliminary versions or planned conference submissions.

rules.quote: required to cite the previous work(s)
rules.requirement: Cite previously published work that forms the basis of the submission.

rules.quote: Copies of any previously published work affiliated with the new submission must also be included as supportive documentation upon submission.
rules.requirement: Provide copies of affiliated previously published work as supporting files.

rules.quote: clearly indicate how the new submission offers substantively novel or different contributions
rules.requirement: Explain substantive new or different contributions relative to prior work.

rules.quote: References should appear in a separate bibliography at the end of the paper.
rules.requirement: Put references in a separate bibliography at the end.

rules.quote: Regular/special-issue paper – 100 to 200 words
Regular/special-issue paper – 100 to 200 words
authors are cautioned to avoid suggesting any individual with whom they may have a real, perceived, or potential conflict of interest
rules.requirement: Do not recommend reviewers or editors with a real, perceived, or potential conflict of interest if recommendations are requested.

rules.quote: potential impact on the construction, analysis, or management of software.
rules.requirement: Explain the paper's potential impact on software construction, analysis, or management.

rules.quote: We accept Microsoft Word, plain text, and LaTeX files.
rules.requirement: Submit manuscript source in an accepted file format.

rules.quote: Files cannot exceed 350 MB.
rules.requirement: Keep each submitted manuscript file within the 350 MB limit.

rules.quote: select the appropriate manuscript type (e.g., “regular paper”).
rules.requirement: Select the proper TSE manuscript type or special issue in the submission system.

rules.quote: All supplemental materials must follow US copyright guidelines
rules.requirement: Ensure supplemental content has the necessary copyright clearance.

rules.quote: upload these files as “supplemental material.”
rules.requirement: Designate supplementary files as supplemental material in the submission system.

rules.quote: All supplemental material must be submitted as separate files and must not be included within the same PDF file as the main paper submission.
rules.requirement: Submit supplementary material as separate files rather than within the main paper PDF.

rules.quote: please include a text file with a description of your supplemental material
rules.requirement: For video or audio supplements, include a text description.

rules.quote: state-of-the-art surveys that provide a synthesis and comprehensive review
rules.requirement: For a survey, synthesize and comprehensively review the area.

rules.quote: well-defined theoretical results and empirical studies
rules.requirement: Present well-defined theoretical results or empirical studies relevant to software engineering.
